fusions.name: Strangler's Heave
fusions.desc: A crushing hold that deals 14 damage, throws the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Flung Viper
fusions.desc: Throws a live viper at an enemy up to 6 tiles away. It deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bough Drop
fusions.desc: Swings you instantly to a point up to 5 tiles away, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Anchored Mass
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (35% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
